## Change class
- [ ] Trivial (typos, links, formatting)
- [ ] Minor (added evidence, clarified wording, no change in recommendation)
- [ ] Significant (new/changed pattern, principle, gate, rubric anchor or weight, deprecation)

## Affected identifiers
<!-- e.g. PAT-MO-004, QG-053, P-07 -->

## Research basis
- Findings file (if research-driven): `research/findings/...`
- Pages fetched and read for this change (URL + access date):
  -

## Source verification (significant / minor)
- [ ] Every cited URL opened and says what the text claims
- [ ] Evidence classes correct (E1 only for normative standard text)
- [ ] Numbers appear verbatim in the source
- [ ] Context and generalizability stated
- [ ] `sources/<publisher>.md` updated
- [ ] Conflicts recorded, not overwritten

## Validation
```
python3 scripts/validate.py --write-index
```
